about:
THE STORM DRAINS review views (tools/bake/sewers/review.py renders them; tools/review/render.py's format). Make: lune run tools/review/export.luau; lune run tools/bake/sewers.luau; for each pipe, lune run tools/bake/sewers/review.luau --pipe

; then /root/.cache/spicy-rodents/venv/bin/python -I tools/bake/sewers/review.py --pipe

. 'pipe' says which scene a view belongs to. Inside a pipe the eye is a squirrel's (a stud over the walkway, on the route's lane); from the pavement a person's. Every lamp is lit (the client lights a space while a squirrel is in it) and the owner's modules are drawn from the FBX files that were uploaded, where the engine pivots them.
